description: Reports one Gmail message as spam. Takes the message ID. The message gets Gmail's SPAM label and leaves the inbox, as the Report spam button does, and Gmail deletes spam for good after 30 days; gmail_unmark_spam moves it back before then. Returns the message ID, whether it is now in spam, and the labels it carries afterwards. Acts on the one message named, not on the rest of its thread.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

message_id.description: The ID of the message to report as spam.

name: gws-mcp__gmail_mark_spam
